A playboy bachelor falls for a woman with chronic short-term memory loss and finds he must woo her every day, all over again.
Two disgraced Black FBI agents go undercover as spoilt blonde heiresses to protect the girls from a kidnapping plot.

p.t: How to Make Love Like an Englishman
p.d: A perennial playboy bachelor, ageing Cambridge professor Richard Haig has his life flipped upside down when he gets his young lover pregnant.

p.t: Mike and Dave Need Wedding Dates
p.d: After placing an ad for respectable dates to a wedding, two party animal brothers find themselves with women more out of control than themselves.

During WWII, a brave but small wood pigeon named Valiant joins Britain's Royal Homing Pigeon Service. When a brigade of evil German falcons threatens their initial mission, Valiant and the rag-tag group of birds from Squad F must save the day.
Bastian finds a mysterious book that draws him into a fantastical world full of strange and fabulous creatures, where he is tasked with defeating a monstrous unseen enemy.
Time for bed! We'll see you first thing in the morning.
After learning surfing was invented by penguins, a documentary crew follows young penguin Cody on his journey to the Penguin World Championships.

A young girl heads from Russia to Paris, hoping to learn if she could be the long lost princess Anastasia. But she and her heroic companions must face the dastardly wizard Rasputin who has sworn to destroy the Russian royal family.

SamSam has it all - great friends, a great family, even his own flying saucer. But what he desperately wants are actual superpowers. While he tries to figure it out, he must prepare to fight monsters and learn what it means to be a hero.
Snoopy and Charlie are on a mission - Charlie aims to impress a girl, while Snoopy takes to the skies in pursuit of his arch-nemesis.

p.t: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
p.d: An inventor tries to solve world hunger only to see things go awry as food starts falling from the sky!
Tired of being alone, the hairy, eight-foot Mr Link embarks on journey to find his long-lost relatives in the fabled valley of Shangri-La.

p.t: Captain Sabertooth and the Countess of Grel
p.d: The Countess of Grel ambushes Captain Sabertooth's ship, stealing a sacred figurehead and kidnapping a young crewmate.

A charming super spy and his geeky scientist companion are almost exact opposites. But what the scientist lacks in social skills he makes up for in invention, creating awesome gadgets for the spy to use on his epic missions.

p.t: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears A Who!
p.d: Horton the elephant struggles to protect a microscopic community from his neighbours who refuse to believe it exists.
An adventurous young girl uses her imagination to escape her reality, but it's rapidly spinning out of control.
Nathan is a little toy who can't do what the other toys can do. Along with his friend Timebot, Nathan goes on an adventure to get fixed.
Despite his best efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his mischievous reputation. Adventuring out of the garden, Peter finds himself in a world where his mischief is appreciated.

Fifteen years after the unsolved murder of his older sister, 24-year-old Daniel finds himself falling for Cassie, a vivacious high school senior. As their romance unfolds, the details sur­round­ing Daniel’s trag­ic past inevitably catch up with them.
After surviving a disaster at sea, a young man is hurtled into an epic journey of discovery with only a fearsome Bengal tiger for company.

p.t: The Life Aquatic With Steve Zissou
p.d: To exact revenge on a shark, an oceanographer rallies a crew, including his estranged wife, a journalist, and a man who may be his son.
A small town hires seven mercenaries to protect them from an evil industrialist and his private army.
Andrew Nieman is a talented jazz drummer at an elite music conservatory. When a famously brutal instructor takes him under his wing, Andrew is pushed to the brink of his abilities, and his sanity.
An elite group of rogue cops pursue a bank robbery crew as the outlaws plan a seemingly impossible heist on the Federal Reserve Bank - the only bank that's never been robbed.

The true story of Aileen Wurnos, a Florida sex worker who became America's first serial killer. After killing a violent client in self-defence, Aileen spirals into a series of murders, while her relationship with her girlfriend fractures.
During the height of the Great War, two young British soldiers embark on a dangerous mission through enemy territory.

During a mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead and left behind. Against all odds, Watney must find a way to survive on an inhospitable planet, and contact Earth in the hopes that they can bring him home.
A desperate father will stop at nothing to save his daughter from being taken away after she is infected with a zombie virus.
In an abandoned monastery at the end of World War II, a young nurse tends to a severely burned plane crash victim. His past is shown in flashbacks, revealing a fateful love affair.
When the president's daughter is trapped in an outer-space prison housing earth's deadliest criminals, the only man who can get her out is a former government agent convicted of treason.
Based on legendary athlete Jim Braddock, a once promising boxer, who makes a comeback carrying the dreams of the disenfranchised on his shoulders.
Desperate to be just like the top cops on the force, two misfit detectives break free from their desk jobs and stumble onto the biggest case of their careers.
During the peak of the space race, three female African American mathematicians played a pivotal role in key NASA missions.
As Dr Kelson continues to build the Bone Temple, he makes a discovery that could change the world. While Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.

A Polish spy working for the British during World War II is betrayed and compromised in Warsaw, leaving her no other choice but to descend into a dangerous world of treachery and deception in order to survive.
The story of the infamous clash between Irish football captain Roy Keane and manager Mick McCarthy, on the eve of the 2002 FIFA World Cup.
A couple find themselves at a crossroads as they move to the countryside - where they encounter a nightmarish force that threatens to corrupt their lives.
Dallas is determined to get into her dream college - the best dance school in the country. But then star quarterback Drayton crashes into her life with a unique story of his own.

Lucy brings her friends home for a holiday in Hawaii. But when her family's gentle pet chimpanzee is bitten by a rabid animal and becomes vicious, their trip turns into a terrifying fight for survival.
In 1940s Australia, a ragtag team of divers are hired to salvage a sunken car from a murky river. However, a vicious bull shark has other ideas.
After agreeing to look after his neighbour's cat, Hank Thompson unexpectedly becomes embroiled in the criminal underbelly of 1990s New York City.
As Dr Kelson continues to build the Bone Temple, he makes a discovery that could change the world. While Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.
The true story of the unstoppable Anthony Robles, who was born with one leg and fought through adversity to become an NCAA champion wrestler.

p.d: In Florida in the early 1970s, an ominous white van stalks a young girl. Her parents' disbelief leads to a terrifying Halloween nightmare. Inspired by a true story.

A writer about to publish his new novel is forced to take care of his mother and three eccentric older women over the course of one chaotic weekend in Dublin.
The powerful true story of Tourette syndrome campaigner John Davidson. Diagnosed as a teen in 1980s Scotland, he struggled with a condition that few understood.

On Christmas Eve, Billy witnesses his parents' grisly murder at the hands of Santa, igniting a lifelong mission to spread holiday fear. Every year he dons the jolly red suit and delivers a blood-soaked killing spree. A twisted reboot of the cult horror classic.
